column1: # Candidate corpora for feature 8 (built in ADR adapters). Columns:
# Method: GitHub code search via 'gh search code --match path', two passes.
#   Pass 2 searched 0010 to 0040 (surfaces deep corpora directly).
#   Counts are exact, taken per repo from the contents API, .md files only.
# LIMITATION: only finds repos using zero padded numeric filenames.
#   A corpus named adr-use-postgres.md is invisible here, so 257 is a
#   floor on how many exist, not a total. Per repo counts are accurate.
# Summary: 257 corpora, median 12 records, 85 with 20 or more, 18 with 50 or more.
# Caution: the two largest (zwasm, ClojureWasm, both .dev/decisions) look
#   agent generated rather than human written. Verify before using as evidence.
# Script: adr-sweep.sh, beside this file. Re-run it to refresh the survey.
